summary.name: 小悟空 (Little Wukong)
summary.one_liner: Little Wukong (小悟空) is a Chinese-language AI assistant site offering a catalog of one-click text-generation templates for writing, planning, and everyday tasks.
use_cases: generate a PPT outline or deck
write Xiaohongshu-style posts and video scripts
draft essays, speeches, or novels from a topic
produce weekly, daily, or OKR reports
practice mock job interviews or English conversation
create contract templates or official documents
summary.what_it_does: The page lists dozens of one-click AI templates, each targeting a specific writing or planning task. Examples include PPT generation, video scripts, Xiaohongshu notes, titles, slogans, novels, speeches, essays, and poems. Work-oriented templates cover PRD, OKR, weekly and daily reports, competitive analysis, contracts, and official documents. Personal and entertainment templates include mock interviews, English practice, a psychology chat, tarot, and a Socratic dialogue persona. The page itself is mostly a marketing list of templates with no technical detail about the underlying model, limits, or how output is produced.
notable: Large catalog of about 70 task-specific one-click templates in Chinese
Covers Chinese social platform content such as Xiaohongshu notes
Includes work templates like PRD, OKR, and weekly report generators
caveats: Page text does not state any pricing details; the '#free' tag in the listing is the only pricing signal
Chinese-language interface; the page does not describe the underlying AI model or data handling
